Hi Jordan / Priya,

Congrats on getting through the initial discovery — excited to get the implementation kickoff lined up. I wanted to share a proposed enablement approach that balances live coaching, short office hours, and an asynchronous "playlist" of walkthroughs so your engineers and product folks can self-serve between sessions.

High-level proposal (this week → first two sprints):
- Week 0 (Dec 14): Coachmarks handoff walkthrough (60 min) — deep-dive on UX hooks, model variant choices, and prefix caching expectations.
- Weeks 1–2: Twice-weekly 30-min office hours (Mon/Thu) for dev Q&A and pairing on integration snippets.
- Async playlist: 6 short recordings (5–12 mins) + an implementation checklist + starter configs for common frameworks.

Can you confirm (a) which engineers will attend the live handoff, (b) timezone constraints, and (c) any items you want prioritized in the kickoff?

Attachments: coachmarks-handoff-checklist.xlsx (draft), enablement-playlist.pdf (outline) — Monica is looped to add calendar invites and the recording links.
